delivery_methodology: The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile approach characterized by short, time-boxed iterations with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative process allows for incremental delivery of features and timely adjustments based on evolving requirements.

AI tools will assist in drafting documentation, code generation, and testing, while human experts will review, integrate, and approve all outputs to maintain quality and alignment with client expectations. Scope changes will be managed carefully to ensure project objectives are met without compromising delivery timelines or quality standards.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to implement a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) to streamline HR operations, improve data accuracy, and enhance employee self-service capabilities. This initiative is critical to supporting the company's growth and ensuring efficient management of employee information and processes.

Exist Software Labs proposes a tailored HRIS solution that integrates key HR functions into a unified platform, delivered through a cloud-hosted microservices architecture. The project will follow a structured delivery schedule culminating in a fully operational system that meets the client's requirements and supports their business objectives.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution consolidates employee information management, leave and attendance tracking, payroll interfacing, and reporting into a single, user-friendly system. It empowers HR staff with tools to maintain accurate records, manage employment movements, and generate essential reports, while providing employees with self-service access to their profiles, leave balances, and payslips.

This solution aligns with Kalinaw Trading Corporation's operational workflows by enabling role-based access, automated notifications, and audit trails to ensure compliance and transparency. The system supports data migration from existing records and integrates seamlessly with the payroll system to facilitate accurate and timely payroll processing.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is designed as a cloud-deployed microservices architecture utilizing Java with Spring Boot for backend services, React for the frontend interface, and PostgreSQL as the data store. This layered architecture separates concerns across application services, data management, and user interface, promoting scalability and maintainability.

Integration with external systems, such as payroll, is handled through secure APIs, while the system supports multiple environments including development, testing (UAT), and production. Security is enforced through role-based access control and comprehensive audit logging, ensuring data integrity and compliance with organizational policies.
warranty_support: A warranty period will follow the system's go-live, during which any defects or issues identified will be promptly addressed and corrected by the project team. Defect reporting will be facilitated through a structured process to ensure timely resolution.

The warranty covers all functionalities delivered as part of the project scope; however, enhancements or additional support beyond this period will be offered as separate service options to meet ongoing client needs. This approach ensures sustained system performance and client satisfaction post-deployment.
